question: Who was appointed the new Director General of the International Solar Alliance (ISA) in November 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ashish Khanna**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Ashish Khanna** was appointed as the new Director General of the International Solar Alliance (ISA) in November 2024.
 
• He succeeded **Ajay Mathur**, who previously held the position as Director General of ISA.
 
• The ISA is a coalition of countries working to promote **solar energy adoption globally** and combat climate change.
 
• Ashish Khanna has extensive experience in renewable energy and has been instrumental in implementing solar energy projects globally, making him a key figure in the sector.
 
• His appointment aligns with the ISA’s mission to lead sustainable solar energy initiatives worldwide.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **International Solar Alliance (ISA):**

 
 
• The ISA was launched in **2015** during the Paris Climate Agreement by India and France.
 
• Its headquarters are located in **Gurugram, Haryana, India**.
 
• The organization aims to bring together **121 member countries**, known as solar-rich nations, located between the Tropics of Cancer and Capricorn.
 
• It focuses on scaling up solar energy deployment, reducing costs, and fostering research and development in solar technologies.
 
 
 
• **Ajay Mathur:**
 
 
• He served as the Director General of ISA from **2021 to 2024**.
 
• Under his leadership, ISA expanded its membership and partnerships significantly, making solar energy more accessible globally.
 
 
 
• **Global Solar Energy Potential:**
 
 
• Solar energy is one of the most promising renewable energy sources, with the potential to meet a significant portion of the world's energy demands.
 
• As of 2024, global solar capacity continues to grow, driven by innovations and international collaborations like ISA.
 
 
 
• **Paris Agreement (2015):**
 
 
• The Paris Agreement is an international treaty on climate change aiming to limit global warming to **below 2°C**, preferably to **1.5°C**.
 
• The ISA was a key initiative launched at COP21 to support this goal by promoting solar energy adoption.
